**Status:** Supported (tier `graphics`). In a shipping tier; the lint, type-check, and code-generation gates cover it. No release promises its signature yet.

## Summary

> Tone mapping controls. ExposureCompensation is in photographic stops (EV;
> +1 doubles brightness), applied before the curve; WhitePoint is the input
> level mapped to display white (its exact meaning is curve-dependent).
